A total of 93 cosmetic surgery–related deaths of U.S. citizens in the Dominican Republic occurred during 2009–2022; all but one occurred in women.
The mean decedent age was 40 years (range = 19–69 years).

notes: data_focus is yes because the report compares its own annual death counts across periods; the 24-decedent review is descriptive. No denominator of U.S. citizens receiving surgery exists, so no risk is computed. The 2019 vs 2020 table columns are side by side and not discussed.
